title: Throttle AppSync resolver creation with wave-ordered data model stacks (429 mitigation)
description: Implements plan section 5 option B in ~/Projects/threat-intelligence-move-plan.md: order the Amplify data model nested stacks into waves (NestedStack.addDependency) so AppSync CreateResolver is not called with full parallelism in new accounts. Config backend.resolverWaveSize, default 12; dependencies only, no resource change. Branch fix/PPY-429wave-appsync-resolver-waves.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch fix/PPY-429wave-appsync-resolver-waves, PR #186 merged into develop (159642f). Mechanism: model nested stacks chained in waves of backend.resolverWaveSize (default 12, 0 disables) via NestedStack.addDependency in amplify/resolver-waves.ts. Full defineSiteBackend synth with vs without waves: 27 DependsOn lists changed (324 edges), no other resource differences, no cycle. CI green (ts, python, smoke). Released v1.0.0-next.40 (PyPI papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev40 built by flow). Not deployed to AWS.
